# Just Zen

A small launcher for macOS and Windows. It is not a browser and has no window you have to keep.

- The panel: a floating strip on the edge of the screen, above every app and on every Space, holding the apps, web apps, groups and documents you move between. Drop a file on an app to open it there. Empty, it stands taller with a glowing ＋.
- ⌥Space: one field over installed applications, documents found through Spotlight (including Google Drive, OneDrive and Proton Drive), a library of about a hundred web apps, any address you type, and the tabs already open in Safari or Chrome. ⌘↵ pins a result to the panel.
- Web apps open in the user's own browser — Safari or Chrome, whichever the machine opens links with — and switch to the tab that already has the site open rather than opening another. Profiles, extensions and logins stay in that browser.
- Deep links: Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT and Slack open through their own URL schemes, so the user lands inside the app.
- Menu bar: settings, the panel toggle, checking for updates and quitting all live in the tray menu. There is no application window at all, and no Dock icon by default on macOS.
- Privacy: no account, no sync, no telemetry. Settings are stored locally and encrypted with the Keychain. Open source: https://github.com/kierankeene122/just-zen

Download: https://justzen.co · macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon, Windows 10 and 11.
